case.title: Enumerator interview lasting exactly 720 s does not fire

submissions.open_text: Water pressure drops every evening so we fill jerrycans early.
The kiosk attendant often closes before noon on Sundays.

case.why: The enumerator minimum is 12 minutes = 720 s and the rule is strictly below. ann lasts exactly 720 s, so too_fast must stay silent. An implementation using <= instead of < would wrongly fire. Other checks are quiet: there are only 2 submissions, so same_spot (needs 2 others) and burst (needs 4) cannot fire. Both points are inside Kondele (lng 34.76-34.78, lat -0.09 to -0.07). The times are 09:15 and 11:40 local. The texts share no content words. There is no voice transcript, and the device is used only by E01.
